As mentioned in #621, the set of Bluetooth devices in the prompt implemented by Chromium is dynamic. This is necessary because Bluetooth device discovery is a gradual process. At best, this could be implemented by waiting for the Bluetooth scan triggered by the appearance of the prompt to time out (usually 30 seconds) before triggering the `requestDevicePromptOpened` event. This would make automated tests quite slow.

Technically this doesn't require any changes to these steps but requires a note that this event can be fired multiple times for the same prompt ID.
